title: Leaving the boats and going west to California
summary: Foster says he left boats several times and was always rehired, then discusses the Los Angeles dance hall where he played in 1922 and 1927.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: See? And every time I leave the boat I go back to the boat. If I'm in New Orleans they'll fire me in New Orleans, then they'll fire me again. See, they'll fire me in St. Louis, they'll fire me in New Orleans. Everywhere they'll fire me, I'll stay. You know what I mean? I know. Well, when you came out west, where'd you play with them at? At the Linguish Dance Hall. That was in 27. That was on 3rd between Los Angeles and- But that's not the first time you came to the West Coast?
No, the first time I came to the West Coast was in 22.
Where? 1-11 Dance Hall. 1-11? Yeah. Where was that? In Los Angeles. On Central Avenue? No, on 3rd between Main and Spring. Oh yeah?
